plan.notes: Source: official Onondaga Community College Undergraduate Catalog 2024-2025 (archived catalog), program page 'Program: Computer Science (A.S.)' (catalog.sunyocc.edu, catoid=11, poid=717). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the catalog's official semester-by-semester sequence (First through Fourth Semester with printed term totals). True degree name per catalog: Computer Science (A.S.). Caveats: (1) Catalog prints 'Total Program Credits: 62-64'. This plan models the 62-credit minimum path: MAT 251 (3) in place of MAT 162 (4) in the second-semester math choice, and the third-semester CSC/MAT elective at 3 credits (catalog allows 3-4). The maximum path (MAT 162 + 4-credit elective) totals 64. (2) The current 2025-2026 catalog program page could not be retrieved with the available tools (catalog index page fetch failed upstream), so catalog_year reflects the actual source used: 2024-2025. (3) Math placement note from catalog: students who do not place into MAT 161 should see their advisor; students with math placement of MAT 114 take MAT 114 in the first semester (takes the place of the semester-4 General Elective category), MAT 143 in the second semester (takes the place of the semester-2 CSC/MAT elective), then MAT 161 in the third semester and MAT 162 in the fourth semester. (4) Catalog note 2: CSC 110 cannot be used to fulfill a CSC elective. (5) Graduation requirement per catalog: students must earn a minimum grade of C in all required CSC courses to receive the A.S. degree. (6) Course prereqs are from the official catalog course descriptions (CSC 112 requires CSC 111; CSC 220 requires CSC 111; CSC 221 requires CSC 112; CSC 211 requires CSC 110 or CSC 111 - CSC 110 is not in this plan, so modeled as CSC 111; the second-semester math choice requires MAT 161; the Lab Science Sequence Part 2 slot points at the Part 1 slot's own code PHY 105). No prereqs invented beyond official catalog statements.
